## Austin Bathroom Repair Provider Checklist

A practical way to compare 5 local handymen or small repair contractors for a faucet leak, towel rack reset, and minor drywall patch is to score the basics that affect total cost and reliability: hourly rate, minimum charge, warranty, response time, and licensing.

## Comparison Template for 5 Affordable Options

| Provider | Hourly Rate | Minimum Charge | Warranty | Response Time | Licensing | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Provider 1 | $___ / hr | $___ | ___ days / months | ___ hours / days | Yes / No | Faucet, hardware, drywall patch scope confirmed |
| Provider 2 | $___ / hr | $___ | ___ days / months | ___ hours / days | Yes / No | Ask if small-job minimum includes materials |
| Provider 3 | $___ / hr | $___ | ___ days / months | ___ hours / days | Yes / No | Confirm drywall texture match and paint touch-up |
| Provider 4 | $___ / hr | $___ | ___ days / months | ___ hours / days | Yes / No | Verify trip charge and after-hours fees |
| Provider 5 | $___ / hr | $___ | ___ days / months | ___ hours / days | Yes / No | Check whether they handle plumbing-adjacent work |

### How to Judge the Best Fit
- **Lowest true cost:** not just hourly rate; include minimum charge, trip fee, and materials.
- **Best for small jobs:** providers with a low minimum charge and fast availability usually win.
- **Safer choice:** prefer someone who can show licensing/registration if plumbing work is involved.
- **Better value:** a short warranty on labor is useful even for minor repairs.
- **Fastest fix:** same-week response matters if the faucet leak could worsen water damage.

## Quote Request Message You Can Send

Hello, I’m looking for a quote for a small bathroom repair job in Austin, TX.

The work includes:
- Fixing a leaking faucet
- Reattaching or securing a loose towel rack
- Patching a small drywall area

Please let me know:
- Your hourly rate
- Minimum service charge
- Any trip or diagnostic fee
- Whether materials are included or billed separately
- Warranty on labor
- Your typical response time
- Whether you are licensed/insured for this type of work

If helpful, I can send photos and a few preferred time windows. Thanks.
